New customer? Make sure they are registered and have a GM number; open their GM folder.
Save every file in that GM folder – never on the Desktop or Downloads.
Choose the printer by its letter (see “Which printer?”).
Quote from the price list; record the sale in Live Sale (WIC on) before handing over. Replies, receipts and payments go in the customer's WhatsApp chat – company number only.
B – scanning, copying, quick A4 colour.
G (or D) – photos and passport photos.
HP black-and-white MFP – black-and-white copies and documents.
A3, or anything else: ask Joe first – the HP M880m (C, E) is reserved for extreme cases.
Large format, binding, stickers: Grony 5.
Lay the pages flat on printer B and scan them (Epson Scan 2, 300 dpi) into the customer's GM folder.
Open the Claude chat “Handwritten transcript”, upload the scan and ask for a Word document.
Check every name, date and number against the handwriting; ask the customer about words you cannot read.
Open it in Word, fix the layout, save it in the GM folder.
Print by letter and hand over with the original.

text: Check, print by letter, save.
Get the customer's details (WhatsApp or in person); ask for anything missing.
Paste them into the matching Claude chat and ask for a Word document in a clean layout.
Check spelling, names, dates and phone numbers with the customer.
Print on B (colour) or the HP black-and-white MFP; save the Word file in the GM folder.
Place the document flat on B; scan to PDF (Epson Scan 2).
Name it with the GM number and what it is, e.g. “GM24 – results slip”.
Send on WhatsApp or email if asked; keep a copy in the GM folder.
Few or colour copies: copy on B. Many black-and-white copies: the HP black-and-white MFP.
Make one copy and check its quality and size, then the rest. Spoilt copies go in WASTE PAPERS.
Staple or sort; hand over with the original.
WhatsApp file: save it from the company WhatsApp on the laptop into the GM folder. Pen drive: scan it with Windows Security, copy the file in, give the drive back.
Open it; check page size, orientation and page count.
Print preview, pick the printer by letter; print the first page and check its quality and size before the rest.
Put the job in a marked envelope in CUSTOMERS' WORK.
Photo paper in G (or D); make sure the paper size on screen matches (4×6, 5×7…).
Open the photo and print at best photo quality, no scaling.
Let it dry before touching; hand over in an envelope.
Plain background, face straight, shoulders level; stand to snap.
Size and crop with the shop's passport photo editor.
Print on 4×6 photo paper (G or D).
Cut with the passport cutter; hand over in a passport envelope.
Switch the laminator ON, set the heater and wait for the ready light.
Put the document inside the right-size pouch; feed the sealed edge first.
Catch it and lay it flat to cool.
At closing: switch off, unplug, let it cool.

Print the confirmation or payment slip; record the sale in Live Sale.

Send it again on another letter (not the M880m unless extreme).
